metric: Queries Calcite can answer from a materialized view that KumoSQL rewrites over the view and proves equivalent; 41 of 41 'cannot' cases (and 8 disabled ones) are not rewritten. Supported subset: 115/139.
correctness: 0 wrong: every rewrite is proven by the prover and re-run against the original on random DuckDB databases (118 verified; `FLOOR(x TO unit)` is checked as DATE_TRUNC)
usefulness: 118 of 196 queries changed (115 expected, 3 in cases Calcite disables); 118 of 118 verified on random databases
held_out: 28/39 reusable (held-out quarter by case-id hash; 29 rewrites, 29 verified, 0 wrong); development 91/108 (HR schema with Calcite's declared keys; 87/108 on the key-free schema), baseline (existing prover alone) 8/108
caveats: Calcite's noMat is not a proof that no rewrite exists, so a rewrite where Calcite says noMat would be checked, not penalised (none occurred). Two ok() tests whose asserted plan never reads the view (Funcs17, Funcs20) are scored as cannot-cases. Developed on the development split; 17 cases use shapes the engine does not read (outer/UKFK joins, INTERSECT ALL, branchwise set-op compensation, DML). Adapted shared-model cases are scored separately (20/20 reusable, 9/9 cannot, 0 wrong). The development figure was re-measured 2026-10-05 with the declared HR keys, the foreign-key-aware random check, derived-table FK elimination and the NOT NULL retry (89/108, 91 rewrites verified), then 91/108 with branchwise set-operation matching of INTERSECT ALL cases (32/32 cannot-cases not rewritten, 0 wrong, 93 rewrites verified); the held-out and all-case numbers above predate that change and are re-measured when the outer-join work lands. Re-measured on master 4d294afd (sqlglot 30.21): 109 to 115 reusable cases rewritten (development 82 to 87, held out 27 to 28), 0 wrong, all 118 rewrites verified. The gain came from changes merged since 2026-10-02; this eval was not developed against in that time, and which change moved which case was not attributed.
